Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career.




Director - Embedded X86 SOC Pre-silicon Emulation / Post Silicon Validation

Core responsibilities

  • SOC Emulation – Lead the pre-silicon emulation and work closely with SOC design teams to validate the new silicon features
  • Silicon bring-up: Lead the initial bringing up of new silicon and work closely with software and firmware teams to support their work.
  • SOC Feature Enablement - Work with IP and SOC Design to define the enablement sequence and define specs
  • SOC Electrical and Functional valdation - Validate the SOC for Functional and Electrical correctness
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work with design, verification, and software teams to resolve problems and meet project goals.
  • Test development and execution: Design, develop, and execute validation tests in C/C++ to functionally test the silicon on physical hardware or emulators.
  • Debugging and root cause analysis: Use lab equipment like logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and protocol analyzers to debug issues, root-cause silicon failures, and verify fixes.
  • Automation: Develop and build automated test suites and validation frameworks to improve efficiency.
  • Reporting: Report on project status and provide feedback to the architecture and design teams.

Required skills and experience

  • System-on-Chip (So C) and ASIC validation: Experience with So C architecture, pre-silicon emulation, and post-silicon ASIC validation.
  • Programming: Proficient in C/C++ and scripting languages like Python or Perl.
  • Lab equipment: Hands-on experience with lab instruments such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and signal generators.
  • Test development: Experience writing and reviewing validation test plans and developing directed, random, and pseudo-random diagnostics.
  • System integration: Ability to bring up and debug systems on various platforms using tools like JTAG.
  • Problem-solving: Strong analytical and debugging skills to find and resolve complex issues.
  • Automation tools: Experience with creating and building automation suites and test automation tools. #LI-LV1

title: Lead Performance Engineer
jobDescription:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Lead Performance Engineer

THE ROLE:

AMD is looking for an outstanding technical leader to drive performance of AMD EPYC Server processors to the next level. Performance analysis of cloud, enterprise, HPC, Machine Learning, and AI headnode workloads from a So C performance architecture perspective.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead performance bring‑up, characterization, and tuning of new silicon for complex server and data‑center workloads across CPU, memory, and interconnect subsystems.
  • Drive root‑cause analysis of performance, power, and stability issues during post‑silicon performance evaluations, working closely with design, architecture, and firmware teams.

  • System and micro-architecture level performance debugs and resolve silicon-level performance and power observations/discrepancies in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Mentor and guide a team of post‑silicon engineers, setting technical direction, best practices, and execution standards.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Strong foundation in CPU core, memory, storage and I/O subsystems
  • Experience in driving Server So C post silicon projects.
  • Power user of performance profiling and hardware performance counter tools
  • Familiarity with complex cloud or enterprise software such as database, data analytics, machine learning, and relevant benchmarks such as SPECCPU, SPECjbb15, etc.
  • Good knowledge of operating systems concepts (e.g. scheduling, memory management, paging, interrupt handling, etc
  • Good programming skills
  • Excellent Data analysis skills (Excel or Python)

title: Lead- System Engineer
jobDescription:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career.




Lead- System Engineer

Roles & Responsibilities for Lead System Engineer:

  1. Assume technical responsibility from Pre-silicon to Post-silicon environment for Feature enablement and So C-System level flow for use cases.
  1. Pre-Silicon: New SOC features enablement, implementation and coverage plan in Emulation
  1. Pre-silicon: Review all Silicon bugs that deferred out SOC Tape out and ensure it does not impact the system level features / use cases.
  1. Post Silicon: Lead the Bring-up planning in collaboration with Silicon teams, Platform, Firmware / BIOS, Post Si Validation team so we have the fastest and functional bring-up as soon as silicon arrives in the lab.
  1. Post Silicon: Partner with SOC NPI PM and be the technical lead to support & debug SOC related challenges from Tape out all the way to SOC IP milestone.
  1. Post Silicon: Lead cross-functional critical silicon issue debug, uplevel and communicate the updates into core teams and Management program reviews.
  1. Post Silicon: Provide inputs to Silicon Validation teams on coverage for New SOC features, enablement, implementation, IPs, and functional coverage at the system level.
  1. Exhibit strong technical leadership on X86 architecture and associated feature implementation
  1. Exhibit great technical depth in the post silicon enablement and validation of both HW and FW aspects to take the right technical decisions for the team

Individual requirements:

  1. Highly skilled engineering professional with over 15 years of experience.
  2. Solid experience in both Pre and Post Silicon enablement and validation with strong BIOS/FW/SW intercepting knowledge.
  1. Solid Experience and Knowledge in the HW and FW aspects of X86 design
  1. Solid experience in connecting the bigger picture across different related domains between Hardware/Firmware and Software and com
  1. Adept in calling out risks while anticipating issues and coming up with appropriate mitigation plans
  1. Experienced in working with the Enablement Manager and Leads, Program Managers, Product Managers, BIOS/FW Managers and other cross functional stakeholders and create a robust alignment setup while running execution.
  1. Preferred experience working with cross-functional teams like DV/Silicon Designers/Pre-silicon/Platform/BIOS/FW/ SW.
  1. Experience in High Speed I/Os like PCIe (preferably Gen4 and above), Memory (DDR4/DDR5.LPDDR4/LPDDR5), USB4.0/3.2/3.1, USB PD, USB Type C, Display interfaces and Ethernet and high-speed interconnects.
  1. Experience in Power Management
  1. Hands-on high speed and board measurement techniques in using high end equipment like Oscilloscopes, Logic Analyzers, Debugger tools, Raspberry PI, Network analyzers, etc.
  1. Preferred experience with scripting using TCL, Python
  1. Excellent communication, collaboration, articulation, upleveling to senior management and team playing skills.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Synergize with the Pre-silicon and DV teams and other stakeholders for proper interception of milestones and risk callouts.
  1. Actively participate in discussions with cross-functional teams in defining and refining test plans and guiding the team for the right path.
  1. Be on top of all issues pertinent to Debug & Triage of any functional issues across the entire validation cycle
  1. Drive meetings for issue closures and actively track schedules and milestone quality metrics
  1. Ensure the Best-in-class Documentation and collateral delivery from the team.

RTL DESIGN ENGINEER

THE ROLE:

The focus of this role is to plan, build, and execute the verification of new and existing features for AMD’s graphics processor IP, resulting in no bugs in the final design.

THE PERSON:

You have a passion for modern, complex processor architecture, digital design, and verification in general. You are a team player who has excellent communication skills and experience collaborating with other engineers located in different sites/timezones. You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and are willing to learn and ready to take on problems.

Job Title: RTL Design Engineer

Location: Hyderabad
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

Looking for strong RTL designer having 7-10 years of experience for Subsystem IP design and SOC Integration in a Product company. This role require strong Subsystem design and SOC quality and constraint development for various Processor and Interconnect based system design that also includes peripherals. The preference is for candidates who have delivered and worked as Subsystem IP lead and understands SOC quality requirements. Strong understanding of Microarchitecture and protocol like AXI/APB are required. The selected person will own subsystem IP Integration for SOCs in deep sub-micron technology.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop Subsystem for Processor (ARM, RISC-V) which will have security and Safety requirements
  • Drive end-to-end Subsystem IP and So C design collateral from concept to production.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional team members for design quality
  • Ensure timely delivery of projects while meeting quality standards.
  • Provide strong technical solution to internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred Experience – 7-10 years

  • Proven experience in SOC design roles with focus on RTL design of subsystem IP and delivery to SOC
  • Expertise in Micro-architecture design and presentation
  • Expertise and strong understanding of RTL quality checks and constraints for Subsystem IP
  • Excellent communication skill
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, including designing experiments for performance
  • Self-motivated and proactive in driving initiatives.

Academic Credentials

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering or Electrical Engineering.

SENIOR SILICON DESIGN ENGINEER

THE ROLE:

AECG SSD ASIC is a centralized ASIC design group within AMD’s Adaptive and Embedded Computing Organization. The group consists of design teams located in several AMD locations in North America and Asia. It is primarily responsible for architecture, design, and implementation of critical Design-for-Test (DFT) and Design-for-Debug (DFD) features for cutting edge AMD products.

THE PERSON:

As a DFx Silicon Design Engineer, you will be working with a team of design engineers from various global design locations on design-for-test (DFT) design and implementation, tool and methodology development, project execution and continuous improvement initiatives, this role provides an excellent growth opportunity for robust individuals looking to make a difference. This is an exciting time to join the AMD team!

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop RTL for ASIC design-for-test (DFT) features as per architectural or design flow automation specifications.
  • Perform DFT RTL design integration, insertion, synthesis, equivalency checking, timing analysis and defining constraints, verification of DFx logic at RTL and GLS, ATPG and Scan GLS.
  • Work with multi-functional teams and handling schedules
  • Developing CAD software, scripts and other support technology to enable successful construction of DFT logics in complex So C design.
  • Performing scan insertion, ATPG verification and test pattern generation
  • Providing DFT feature bring-up and pattern debug support to production engineering team during first silicon bring-up, qualification and failure analysis.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Knowledge of DFT techniques such as JTAG/IEEE standards, SSN, Scan and ATPG, memory BIST/repair or Logic BIST
  • Expertise in scan compression architecture, scan insertion and ATPG methodologies are essential.
  • Working knowledge and experience in Verilog simulator and waveform debugging tools, proficiency in debugging both RTL and gate level simulations
  • Good working knowledge of UNIX/Linux and scripting languages (e.g. TCL, c-shell, Perl)
  • Familiar with Verilog design language, Verilog simulator and waveform debugging tools
  • Knowledge of EDA tools/methodology, such as synthesis, equivalency checking, static timing analysis is a plus.
  • Understanding various technologies that must work with DFT/DFD technology such as CPU’s, memory and I/O controllers, etc. is a plus
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Team player with strong communication skills.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical/Electronic Engineering with 5+Yrs

title: FPGA Architect (CAD & EDA Flows)
jobDescription:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career.




FPGA Silicon Architecture Engineer (CAD & EDA Flows)

THE ROLE:

The AMD FPGA Architecture team (in Bangalore) is seeking motivated engineers to advance power efficiency and performance of current and next‑generation FPGA devices through interdisciplinary architectural innovation. This work spans circuit and CAD methodologies, power–performance analysis and tradeoffs, algorithmic optimization, silicon and board‑level characterization, sensor design, and data‑driven modeling using statistical and machine‑learning techniques across pre‑ and post‑silicon phases.

THE PERSON:

You are passionate about modern VLSI architectures, algorithms, and applying machine‑learning and statistical techniques to improve designs, flows, and architectures. You are motivated to make tangible impact on design methodology, reliability, and energy efficiency of silicon devices on advanced technology nodes. You collaborate effectively across interdisciplinary teams and bring strong analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, and a clear bias towards taking ideas from concept to execution and closure.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Explore and develop new circuit techniques, methodologies, and architectural concepts to improve power efficiency and performance in FPGA devices
  • Design and implement sensors, measurement infrastructures, and test vehicles to collect power‑performance data from silicon and hardware platforms
  • Build high‑level analytical and data‑driven models for circuit, architectural, and power‑management features across pre‑ and post‑silicon phases
  • Analyze power‑performance tradeoffs using architectural, algorithmic, and modeling approaches to guide design decisions
  • Collaborate closely with FPGA architects, hardware, CAD, and system engineers to define, validate, and drive new architectural and power‑management features to execution

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

Core Background:

  • 5+ years of overall experience, including 3+ years across one or more of the following domains: ASIC/FPGA design, VLSI architecture, VLSI CAD, software/algorithm development, or closely related areas
  • Strong expertise in one or more of the following:
    • FPGA or VLSI architecture and design methodologies
    • Algorithm development and optimization for hardware‑aware power, performance, or efficiency analysis
    • CAD flows and methodologies, particularly for power, timing, reliability, yield, or design closure
    • Application of machine‑learning or statistical‑learning techniques for modeling, prediction, or optimization of pre‑ and post‑silicon behavior
  • Experience working on software, CAD, or algorithmic projects with a clear interest in hardware, architecture, or silicon‑level impact

Desirable / Domain‑Specific Experience:

  • Strong knowledge of FPGA architectures (Xilinx or equivalent)
  • Hands‑on experience with FPGA design tools such as Xilinx Vivado or equivalent
  • Proficiency in RTL design using Verilog and/or System Verilog
  • Strong digital circuit and logic design fundamentals, with familiarity in SPICE‑based circuit simulation

If in doubt, send your resume and let us decide.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical, or Instrumentation Engineering with a minimum of 4 years of relevant industry experience
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, or related fields with a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience
  • Ph D with demonstrated research publications in the candidate’s focus area and a broad interest in applying research to real‑world silicon, architecture, or design challenges

  • Contribute to open-source Linux Kernel driver initiatives.

  • A powerful desire to learn new skills and understand new features as they are added

  • Excellent Communication and Presentation skills.
  • Responsible for exploring opportunities to improve product 
  • Work closely with other team members to understand design architecture and to propose solutions to improve and enhance products.

  • Exposure to systems architecture 
  • Engineer with 14+ Yrs of experience in developing Linux system software and kernel mode drivers.
  • Proficient in C/C++ programming for operating system kernel & systems development.
  • Strong debugging skills on complex, multi‑threaded systems
  • Deep understanding of multi‑core architectures, NUMA, and memory hierarchies
  • Ability to produce high-quality code with strong communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Solid understanding of operating systems, with emphasis on Linux or any other UNIX-like operating system.
  • Experience with concurrent programming, threading APIs, and OS development on Linux.
  • Deep understanding of operating systems concepts, data structures, and at least one general-purpose processor architecture (knowledge of x86-64 architecture is a bonus).
  • Proficiency in Linux kernel development, strong understanding with Linux modules like Scheduler, Memory management, IPC, DMA,IOMMU, Interrupt/event handler etc.
  • Familiarity with embedded systems and hardware-software integration, with a collaborative approach in a fast-paced environment.
  • Hands-on issue debugging skills, issue isolation with Linux kernel, driver module level, System knowledge, System Debugging.

  • Hands on experience in PCIe subsystem, PCIe Drivers, Ethernet, IOMMU, System level debugging, Linux Kernel Programming, 
    Scheduler, Memory management, Interrupt architecture.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical Engineer, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related field

title: Post Silicon Memory Enablement Engineer - DDR/LPDDR
jobDescription:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career.




Sr. SILICON DESIGN ENGINEER : Post Silicon Memory Enablement

THE ROLE:

We are looking for a dynamic, energetic and a strong Enablement Engineer for Memory Enablement in Post silicon x86 environment, join our growing team.

The successful candidate will work as part of the post-silicon validation group, enablement of memory features including training/margining and memory subsystem implementation, working with engineering teams across AMD and with the vendor eco-system. Candidate will be immersed in challenging work, developing and executing enablement and feature test plans and reports throughout the execution to meet project milestones at POR quality. The candidate should be able to work in a global environment while maintaining a synergetic culture.

As a key contribution to the success of AMD’s product, you will be part of a leading team to drive and improve AMD’s abilities to deliver the highest quality, industry-leading technologies to market. In this role you will facilitate the enablement efforts of a program to ensure timely and qualitative completion of the milestones and adhere to the program commitments.

SKILL SET

  • 4+ years of silicon validation for multiple any So Cs especially x86 containing multi core CPU/GPU subsystems with focus on memory technologies like DDR5/LPDDDR5
  • Good understanding of CPU subsystem in x86 / any So C environment with Strong and Proven expertise in conducting tests and experiments towards enabling memory during Boot and Post -boot enablement
  • Good understanding of x86 HW, FW and BIOS Architecture
  • Strong understanding of Memory Subsystem including the Memory PHY and Controller understanding, various DDR/LPDDr topologies and configurations, and ecosystem collaboration
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration abilities
  • Exposure to certain stages of Silicon Validation will be crucial, including use-case validation.
  • Practical experience of working on Processor based system designs is a plus
  • Knowledge of shell programming/scripting (e.g. Tcl Perl, Python etc.)
  • Hands-on experience dealing with Memory Analyzers

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Conducting day-to-day experiments for Memory enablement
  • Maintaining Test plans and reports and scrubbing the JIRA tickets on a periodic basis
  • Developing required test scripts for small tasks
  • Problem solving - the successful candidate loves debugging complex problems and has a track record of doing so
  • Work with the Memory Lead and senior members in refining the processes, and demonstrate keen interest to learn and explore new methods/ideas pertaining to memory subsystem

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in computer engineering/Electrical Engineering

title: Senior Firmware Developer
jobDescription:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career.




MTS SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER

THE ROLE:

AMD is looking for a specialized software engineer who is passionate about improving the performance of key applications and benchmarks. You will be a member of a core team of incredibly talented industry specialists and will work with the very latest hardware and software technology.

THE PERSON:

The ideal candidate should be passionate about software development with a mindset of what can go wrong for all possible use cases, all corner cases, problem solving skills. The candidate will also be involved in areas including verification and automation. Able to communicate effectively across teams across AMD, self-driven, motivated, and result oriented.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Work with HW architecture/design teams to derive SW safety requirements
  • Develop low level safety critical firmware for SW requirements using C or assembly language for ARM V7/V8 architecture-based So C systems
  • Integrate the firmware into system software stack, considering the feasibility, performance, freedom from interference, multicore architectural aspects
  • Independently develop the code, work in collaboration with appropriate stakeholders ensuring that implementation satisfies the assigned requirements
  • Design, implementation and verification of safety critical software to the extent required for the safety integrity level
  • Produce necessary documentary evidence to aid in safety qualification
  • Communicate results, issues, concerns, and risks to management

REQUIRED SKILLS:

Experience: 8-12 years

  • Proficiency in C and Assembly language
  • Experience of systems based upon FPGA and SOC architecture
  • Experience of working with hardware engineers for HW/SW integration
  • Good understanding of ARM V8, V7 architecture and preferably cortex A53, R52, A72 processors, bus interface protocols (AXI, AHB etc.) and peripherals (CAN, ethernet, USB, SD, memory controllers etc.)
  • Good knowledge and hands-on experience in designing and developing embedded software including drivers, BSP, boot code, boot loaders
  • Good understanding of system software stack: Linux/Vx Works, hypervisors
  • Very good debugging and analyzing capabilities
  • Good knowledge of tools (design & verification) and environments for software development
  • Very good communication (verbal and written) and teamwork skills

DESIRED SKILLS:

  • Safety oriented analyses (both SW & HW) such as FMEA, FMEDA, DFA
  • Knowledge of automotive software development stack, AUTOSAR, MISRA coding standards etc.
  • Experience in using AMD Vivado/Vitis tools
  • Working knowledge of scripting languages (e.g. Perl, Tcl, shell)
  • Knowledge of Machine learning domain, frameworks (tensor flow, ENET etc.)
  • Knowledge of AI tools, and ability to adapt them in reducing turnaround time for SW development

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Electronics / Electrical Engineering, or equivalent

title: SOC / System Validation Architect
jobDescription:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career.




SOC / System Validation Architect

Roles & RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Validation Architecture & Strategy

  • Define end‑to‑end So C validation architecture spanning pre‑silicon (simulation, emulation, FPGA) and post‑silicon validation.
  • Drive validation strategy alignment with So C architecture, use‑cases, and product requirements.
  • Architect coverage models (functional, scenario, performance, power, security, RAS).
  • Define shift‑left validation methodologies to uncover system issues early.

2. Pre‑Silicon Validation Leadership

  • Lead validation architecture using:
    • Simulation (UVM‑based, hybrid environments)
    • Emulation / acceleration platforms
    • FPGA‑based prototyping
  • Enable system‑level use‑case validation involving CPU, GPU, accelerators, IOs, memory, and fabrics.
  • Guide complex cross‑IP and cross‑subsystem debug (RTL, firmware, software interactions).

3. Post‑Silicon & Silicon Bring‑Up

  • Architect post‑silicon validation frameworks, diagnostics, and automation.
  • Drive early silicon bring‑up, debug, and characterization.
  • Ensure validation of performance, power, thermals, security, and RAS features.
  • Partner with manufacturing and product teams to support production readiness.

4. Cross‑Functional Technical Leadership

  • Act as a technical authority across validation, influencing design decisions upstream.
  • Collaborate with:
    • So C Architects
    • IP owners
    • Firmware / BIOS teams
    • System software and OS teams
  • Represent validation in architecture reviews, tape‑out readiness, and exec forums.

THE PERSON:

A successful candidate will work with senior silicon design and validation engineers. The candidate will be highly accurate and detail-oriented, possessing good communication and problem-solving skills.

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in So C validation, or system architecture.
  • Deep expertise in So C validation methodologies (pre‑ and post‑silicon).
  • Strong understanding of:
    • CPU/GPU architectures
    • Interconnects and fabrics (No C)
    • Memory subsystems (DDR, HBM, cache coherency)
    • High‑speed IOs (PCIe, Ethernet, USB, CXL, etc.)
  • Hands‑on experience with emulation platforms.
  • Proven strength in complex system‑level debug across HW/FW/SW boundaries.
  • Excellent communication and technical influence skills.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

    • Experience validating server, datacenter, automotive, or high‑performance So Cs.
    • Expertise in RAS, security, and safety validation.
    • Experience with production silicon ramp and yield learning.
    • Prior role as technical architect or fellow‑level contributor.
    • Publications, patents, or industry leadership contributions are a plus.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in computer engineering/Electrical Engineering

title: Lead Embedded Linux kernel device driver development engineer
jobDescription:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career.




THE ROLE:

We are seeking an engineer to join our team that will thrive in a fast-paced work environment, using effective communication, problem-solving and prioritization skills. Individuals that are well organized, show great attention to detail, and employ critical thinking are well-suited for our team.

The AMD Embedded Linux X86 Software Driver development engineering team is seeking a passionate Linux Kernel Engineer
in our Linux Operating Systems team – bring a willingness to learn and absorb new concepts and technologies, along with a sound understanding of computer architecture and operating system concepts
designed for the x86-64 architecture.

Design, develop, Integrate core CPU, GPU and SOC features/drivers for the Linux kernel and related open-source projects.

This opportunity gets you involved in all phases of software development. Work with the internal multiple component teams, architecture, customers and upstream Linux Kernel community to
develop these features, enahanced, productized for Automotive, Networking and Storage, Industrial segments.

THE PERSON:

This AMD (Advanced Micro Devices) team is looking for a senior level person that can help guide the team, mentor upcoming developers, provide long range strategy, and is willing to jump in to help resolve issues quickly. You will be involved in all areas that impact the team including Requirement analysis, Feasibility analysis, Design, development. The right candidate will be informed on the latest trends and become prepared to give consultative direction to senior management.

An aspiring Linux kernel developer with a strong grounding in Linux system expertise and hands-on experience and operating systems concepts who will develop skills to deliver responsive and efficient solutions that bring new AMD processors to market.
Utilize polished written and verbal communication to work with both local and global colleagues towards a common end goal.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Collaborate internal central engineering teams and develop new features, Integration, Bug fixes and productization of the Linux platform driver stack.
  • Lead architecture and design of high‑performance packet processing frameworks using DPDK.
  • Design and implement DPDK-based applications and libraries.
  • Optimize performance for multi‑core, NUMA, cache efficiency, huge pages, and zero‑copy I/O.
  • Profile and tune systems using tools like perf, ftrace, dpdk-proc-info, pktgen, etc.
  • Integrate DPDK with Linux networking stack, user‑space and kernel‑space components.
  • Deep involvement with Linux internals, including:
    • Memory management
    • Scheduler
    • Interrupts, NAPI, and polling mechanisms
    • PCIe, DMA, and device drivers
  • Work with NIC drivers, offloads (RSS, TSO, LRO, checksum), and hardware accelerations.
  • Experience with kernel bypass techniques and zero‑copy frameworks
  • Experience with virtual networking: vhost‑user, virtio, SR‑IOV, OVS‑DPDK
  • Collaborate with firmware, hardware, validation, and customer teams
  • Contribute to open‑source communities (DPDK/Linux) is a strong plus
  • Collaborate with hardware and software teams to resolve Linux OS, Kernel, Driver issues.
  • Analyze and debug critical low-level driver, hardware, and OS issues
  • Build and maintain strong technical relationships with internal teams and external partners
  • Contribute to open-source Linux Kernel driver initiatives.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and best practices.
  • A powerful desire to learn new skills and understand new features as they are added
  • Proven record of accomplishment of working within and across groups.
  • Excellent Communication and Presentation skills.
  • Responsible for exploring opportunities to improve product
  • Work closely with other team members to understand design architecture and to propose solutions to improve and enhance products.
  • Join the talented group of linux kernel engineers working on various core subsystems such as GFX, Multimedia, Display, Virtualization, Power and Performance management, Ethernet, DPDK, SPDK, SDXI, PCIe, IOMMU, etc

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Exposure to systems architecture
  • Engineer with 13+ Yrs of experience in developing Linux system software and kernel mode drivers.
  • Proficient in C/C++ programming for operating system kernel & systems development.
  • Strong debugging skills on complex, multi‑threaded systems
  • Deep understanding of multi‑core architectures, NUMA, and memory hierarchies
  • Ability to produce high-quality code with strong communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Solid understanding of operating systems, with emphasis on Linux or any other UNIX-like operating system.
  • Experience with concurrent programming, threading APIs, and OS development on Linux.
  • Deep understanding of operating systems concepts, data structures, and at least one general-purpose processor architecture (knowledge of x86-64 architecture is a bonus).
  • Proficiency in Linux kernel development, strong understanding with Linux modules like Scheduler, Memory management, IPC, DMA,IOMMU, Interrupt/event handler etc.
  • Familiarity with embedded systems and hardware-software integration, with a collaborative approach in a fast-paced environment.
  • Hands-on issue debugging skills, issue isolation with Linux kernel, driver module level, System knowledge, System Debugging.
  • Knowledge of software development tools, including debuggers and version control systems (e.g., Git, Git Hub).
  • Hands on experience in PCIe subsystem, PCIe Drivers, Ethernet, IOMMU, System level debugging, Linux Kernel Programming,
    Scheduler, Memory management, Interrupt architecture.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical Engineer, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related field

jobDescription:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career.




MTS SYSTEMS DESIGN ENGINEER

THE ROLE:

We are looking for a dynamic, energetic Lead / Senior Systems Design Engineer to join our growing team. As a key contributor to the success of AMD’s product, you will be part of a leading team to drive and improve AMD’s abilities to deliver the highest quality, industry leading technologies to market. The Systems Design Engineering team fosters and encourages continuous technical innovation to showcase successes as well as facilitate continuous career development.

THE PERSON:

As a Systems Design Engineer, you will drive balanced, scalable, and automated solutions. In this high visibility position, your software systems engineering expertise will be necessary towards product development, definition, and root cause resolution.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Driving technical innovation to improve AMD’s capabilities across validation, including tool and script development, technical and procedural methodology enhancement, and various internal and cross-functional technical initiatives
  • Debugging issues found during the process, bring-up, validation, and production phases of SOC programs
  • Working with multiple teams, and tracking test execution to make sure all features are validated and optimized on time
  • Working closely with supporting technical teams
  • Engaging in other software/hardware modeling frameworks
  • Leading collaborative approach with multiple teams

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Significant 7+ years of relevant experience in complex So C verification & Validation
  • Prior hands-on experience with FPGA and/or emulation platforms (Veloce, Palladium, ZEBU, HAPs, Protium)
  • Developing C/C++/Uefi based test content.
  • Validating hardware features for at least 3 or more projects in a pre-silicon environment
  • Debugging failures using waveform viewers, log files and microcode trace dumps
  • Knowledge of low power design emulation/verification and power management fundamentals
  • Knowledge of UEFI, Windows Operating Systems
  • Knowledge of x86 and/or ARM So C Architecture
  • Knowledge of Memory subsystem, high speed IO peripherals like PCIe, USB, NPU, So C & IP level Power Management flow, Security protocols.
  • Knowledge of one or more protocols; SPI, DDR, SATA, USB, AXI, PCI, PCIe, MIPI.
  • Good to have Post Silicon Validation Experience on CPU/Power Management/HSIO -PCIe/USB using Embedded C and BIOS
  • Extensive knowledge of system architecture, technical debug, and validation strategy
  • Strong analytical/problem-solving skills and pronounced attention to details
  • Must be a self-starter, and able to independently drive tasks to completion

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in electrical or computer engineering

title: Senior Technical Leader SW Development
jobDescription:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career.




Senior Technical Leader – Robotics Software SDK Development

WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

AMD’s Robotics and Physical AI initiatives require senior technical leaders to define and build a modern, high‑performance Robotics Software SDK that accelerates development across navigation, perception, manipulation, sensing, heterogeneous compute, and AI acceleration. The PMTS role is a high‑impact technical leadership position, consistent with AMD’s technical career ladder, and spans architecture, cross‑team collaboration, and sustained innovation in the robotics software ecosystem.

THE ROLE

As a Principal Member of Technical Staff (PMTS) in Robotics Software SDK Development, you will architect, design, and deliver a comprehensive robotics software stack leveraging AMD’s APU platforms, accelerators, sensor interfaces, and open‑source robotics frameworks. You will drive AMD’s robotics ecosystem enablement—including ROS2, Vulkan/ROCm accelerators, simulation toolchains, navigation and perception modules, and integrated AI pipelines

You function as a technical leader across organizational boundaries, guiding system design decisions, SDK API definitions, performance optimization, and cross‑functional alignment with silicon, platform, AI, and customer engineering teams.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Robotics SDK Architecture & Development

  • Define and own the architecture, design principles, and roadmap for AMD’s Robotics Software Development Kit, aligned with AMD’s adaptive compute and sensor‑fusion roadmap
  • Build core modules for:
    • Perception (camera/Li DAR/IMU fusion, accelerated vision pipelines via ROCm/Vulkan)
    • Navigation (NAV2, SLAM, motion planning)
    • Manipulation (Move It–based planning stacks)
    • Simulation interfaces (Gazebo, O3DE/Robotec.ai)
  • Ensure SDK compatibility across AMD hardware platforms (x86, So Cs, FPGAs/ACAP, Ryzen AI, R8000 families) as described in robotics strategy files (Robotics Strategy...).

2. Performance, Optimization & Accelerators

  • Architect and optimize compute pipelines, leveraging ROCm, GPU compute, AIE/FPGA acceleration, and hardware‑assisted libraries (Robotics Strategy...).
  • Define performance KPIs and lead profiling, benchmarking, and tuning of robotics workloads on AMD hardware.

3. Cross‑Functional Technical Leadership

  • Provide consultative direction to senior leadership, consistent with PMTS expectations
  • Collaborate with:
    • Silicon/platform architects
    • AI/ML teams (Ryzen AI, ROCm)
    • Sensor and I/O engineering
    • OS/hypervisor teams (Linux, TSN, Ether CAT, Xen, etc.)
    • Field and customer engineering teams

4. Open‑Source Ecosystem Engagement

  • Represent AMD in ROS2, simulation, and robotics open‑source communities.
  • Contribute upstream enhancements for AMD acceleration backends (ROCm, Vulkan compute, AIE, Tiny ML).

5. Productization, Quality & SDK Lifecycle Management

  • Establish SDK release processes, documentation standards, API stability guidelines, and reference application examples
  • Ensure cross‑version compatibility, dependency resolution, and packaged deployment across Linux distributions, containers, and edge devices.

6. Mentorship & Organizational Impact

  • Mentor senior engineers and influence cross‑team technical decision‑making, as expected of a PMTS
  • Drive innovation through patents, technical papers, internal demos, and reviews with executives.

THE PERSON

Required Attributes

  • Recognized subject‑matter expert in robotics software, SDK architecture, or heterogeneous compute systems.
  • Proven ability to operate at principal‑level scope, influencing across multiple AMD organizations
  • Excellent communication, mentoring, and cross‑functional alignment skills.

Technical Qualifications

  • 15+ years in robotics, embedded systems, or advanced compute software engineering.
  • Deep expertise in:
    • ROS2, navigation/perception stacks
    • C++, Python, modern software architecture
    • GPU and accelerator programming (ROCm, Vulkan, Open CL)
    • Real‑time systems, TSN, industrial interfaces (Ether CAT, CANFD, etc.)
    • Simulation tools (Gazebo, O3DE, Foxglove)
  • Experience integrating AI/ML pipelines into robotics systems (AIE, Tensor Flow, Py Torch, ONNX).

Preferred Experience

  • Contributions to open‑source robotics or GPU ecosystems.
  • Experience with complex So C platforms and hardware/software co‑design.
  • Demonstrated history of innovation, patents, or technical leadership roles.

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Ph D preferred for advanced robotics/AI/compute specialization.

Define performance KPIs and lead profiling, benchmarking, and tuning of robotics workloads on AMD hardware. 3. Cross‑Functional Technical Leadership Provide consultative direction to senior leadership , consistent with PMTS expectations Collaborate with: Silicon/platform architects AI/ML teams (Ryzen AI, ROCm) Sensor and I/O engineering OS/hypervisor teams (Linux, TSN, EtherCAT, Xen, etc.) Field and customer engineering teams 4. Productization, Quality & SDK Lifecycle Management Establish SDK release processes, documentation standards, API stability guidelines, and reference application examples Ensure cross‑version compatibility, dependency resolution, and packaged deployment across Linux distributions, containers, and edge devices. 6. title: Manager – Post silicon Validation
jobDescription:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career.




MANAGER – Post Silicon So C Validation and Power/Performance

THE ROLE:

As Manager-Post Silicon IP Validation in Embedded Group, you will own strategic planning, execution, and leadership for So C enablement/validation, and power/performance attainment for highly leveraged embedded products. By managing both internal and external deliverables, you will work to ensure all embedded new products are executed and delivered on time. This critical and highly visible role provides an excellent growth opportunity for high performing individuals looking to make a difference and deliver a stand-out experience to customers of AMD.

THE PERSON:

A successful candidate will have the ability to establish and drive to goals including plan of record, timelines, budget, scope, performance, and quality. A candidate must be self-motivated, must have a passion for working with a diverse team of creative engineers and senior executives, must be able to deftly manage both internal and external dependencies and ensure all embedded products are delivered on time. This role requires strong technical expertise in semiconductor systems, cross-functional collaboration, people management skills, and proven leadership in managing complex silicon validation programs. The candidate must be a team player with a commitment to meeting deadlines and an aptitude to thrive in a fast paced, multi-tasking environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • So C Enablement/Validation/Debug Activities
    • Drive post-silicon IP enablement and functional/electrical validation activities
    • Identify and drive compliance activities with internal central teams and external labs
    • Ensure appropriate validation coverage across the IPs at various temperature range
    • Oversee critical debug and triage towards any Silicon related issues
  • So C Power and Performance Attainment
    • Drive the teams for the bounding box attainment and ensuring validation for power/performance across PVT conditions
    • Oversee EDC/TDC tuning, Ca C validation, and comprehensive power and thermal characterization
  • Leadership & Team Development
    • Build and mentor a high-performing team across the various domains
    • Define team goals, priorities, and meet execution plans aligned with program milestones
    • Plan headcount and allocate resources effectively
    • Collaborate with multi-functional leaders to drive AMD’s success
  • Risk Management & Issue Resolution:
    • Identify and mitigate risks related to feature enablement and validation coverage; ensure timely triage and resolution of blocking issues
    • Lead triage and resolution of blocking issues in coordination with architecture, validation, and debug teams.
  • Stakeholder Communication:
    • Provide crisp progress updates to management and stakeholders.
    • Maintain dashboards on status and issues for projects and deliverables in Confluence and use Jira/MS Project to track all the engineering work

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Technical background in semiconductor industry with 5 years hands on work in Pre-Silicon activities, 5 years of program management experience and an overall industry experience of 15+ years
  • Good understanding of So C architecture, RTL integration, and platform-level validation functions
  • Working experience handling Post-Silicon IP level enablement and validation activities
  • Hands-on with debug, triage, and validation procedures for all the interfaces and subsystems
  • Good exposure with resource and budget management for the team
  • Strong mentoring and coaching skills
  • Prior experience managing and leading engineering teams
  • Proven project & program management experience in dynamic and competitive industry
  • Ability to manage complex programs with multiple cross-functional dependencies.
  • Proficiency in planning tools (JIRA, Confluence, Sharepoint, MS Project) and reporting dashboards
  • Ability to structure and execute complex analysis, draw insights, and communicate summary findings/recommendations to senior management.
  • Ability to network, build relationships, and drive effective decision-making across multiple functions and levels within the organization
  • Highly organized, able to prioritize, and juggle multiple work streams to tight deadlines
  • Flexible working schedule to manage global (Asia and North America) program execution teams
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in computer engineering/Electrical Engineering
  • Engineering degree with 15+ years of industry experience
  • Excellent communication and inter-personal skills.

title: CPU Performance Modelling - Cores
jobDescription:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career.




SMTS SILICON DESIGN ENGINEER

THE ROLE:

The CPU Microarchitecture and Performance Modeling team at AMD Bangalore is looking for engineers with BTech, MTech or Ph D with relevant experience of 10+ years to work on AMD’s next generation processor microarchitecture development. This team is the biggest CPU architecture and performance modeling team at AMD and is playing a very important role in AMD’s all CPU microarchitecture work.
The person will be part of AMD’s highly experienced and talented team of engineers working on microarchitecture development and processor performance modeling and will work closely with AMD’s CPU and SOC performance architects.

THE PERSON:

A successful candidate will work with senior silicon design engineers, architects, RTL writers. The candidate will be highly accurate and detail-oriented, possessing good communication and problem-solving skills.

KEY RESPONSIBLITIES:

  • Strong knowledge of computer architecture with good experience of working and developing microarchitectural timing simulator, C++ programming.
  • Beside architecture and C++ programming knowledge, if the candidate has one or more of the following, it will be considered to be a big plus:
  • Workloads characterization, program analysis, benchmarking using actual hardware performance counters or different tools.
  • Knowledge of python or some other scripting language, Verilog/VHDL
  • x86 assembly language programming
  • Exploring microarchitectural ideas and evaluating them for AMD’s future processors
  • Modeling various micro-architectural features on simulator and evaluating their performance.
  • Developing tests to measure performance on simulator, actual hardware and RTL design
  • Benchmark characterization and bottleneck analysis on different hardware platforms

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s or Ph D. degree in computer engineering/computer science
